title: Delete dead code: ten modules and three scripts nothing imports, 26 modules only their own tests use, and images nothing references

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: Import-graph scan (resolving @/ and relative specifiers, tests counted separately) over 4,115 non-test candidates: no importer and no path mention for components/frequency/site/pages/shared/wired-in.tsx (17 lines), components/hunts/hunt-consent-panel.tsx and hunt-donation-ask.tsx, components/marketplace/etsy-preview.tsx, components/sites/temple-kit-inner/pages-e.ts, components/widgets/space-profile/space-profile-modules.fixture.ts, lib/editor-crdt/draft-writer.ts and draft-revision.ts, lib/hunts/sponsor-milestone.ts, lib/importer/fixtures/wellness-studio.ts. Hunts and editor CRDT are intentionally dark, so those may be waiting to be wired, not abandoned. || Same scan, 'test-only' bucket: components/spaces/dashboard/space-dashboard.tsx (446 lines, only referenced as a path string in tests), components/studio/market/new-listing-button.tsx, components/frequency/site/pages/pricing/tier-graphics.tsx (only a CSS comment mentions it), components/admin/admin-rail-drawer-column.tsx, components/sites/services-chrome.tsx, components/spaces/spaces-sort.tsx, lib/nav/admin-rail.ts, lib/layout/header-offset.ts, lib/ai/autodoc.ts, lib/ai/space-copilot-eval.ts, lib/apps/adapters.ts, lib/calendar-sync/google.ts, lib/commerce/discounts.ts, lib/help/drift.ts, lib/importer/launch.ts, lib/hunts/* (consent, donation-ask, outbox, rewards) and lib/sites/{alli-rae,house-of-fates,new-world}-site.ts. Some are used from scripts or probes, not app code, which the scan does not count. || Searching package.json, .github, vercel.json, docs, scripts, test, lib, app for each scripts/* filename: only scripts/merge-ready.mjs, scripts/post-merge.sh, scripts/space-email-program.test.mjs have zero references. Everything else in the 386-file scripts/ dir is wired (package.json, CI, docs or ledger probes). The .test.mjs extension is not collected by vitest or playwright testMatch. || Basename not found in app/components/lib/content/scripts/tests: public/images/site/{downward-dog,kundalini-group-outdoor,outdoor-yoga}.jpg and fd40d12c-....jpg (0 refs each); public/brand/frequency/facilities/*.jpg and email/hero-5.jpg. Name scan flags 511 of 843 public files (55,976 KB) but themes-index/s, themes/*/shots etc. are built from dynamic path templates (use-kit-showcase.ts:29,268), so only the static-image ones are confirmed. public/screenshots/home-*.jpg ARE used by public/manifest.json:54,61.

WHY IT MATTERS: Dead weight in tsc and review; wired-in.tsx, etsy-preview.tsx, pages-e.ts and the fixture are likely truly abandoned. A 446-line dashboard and a pricing graphic that ship in no route are either unwired features or leftovers; each is a possible dropped launch item. space-email-program.test.mjs likely never runs, so its assertions guard nothing. merge-ready.mjs and post-merge.sh are agent tooling that may be intentionally manual. Dead bytes in the deploy artifact; the repo gates the artifact size (check:build-budget). Small win unless the dynamic set is also trimmed.

FIX DIRECTION: Delete wired-in.tsx, etsy-preview.tsx, pages-e.ts, wellness-studio fixture; leave hunts/editor-crdt ones until Jan 31 then wire or delete. For each, decide wire, move under scripts/test, or delete. space-dashboard.tsx and tier-graphics.tsx first. Rename the .test.mjs to .test.ts so vitest runs it, or delete; document or delete the other two. Delete the 4 images/site orphans after a manual check; audit themes/ and sites/ against their manifests with a build-time script.

PARTIAL 2026-11-16 (row stays open): deleted components/frequency/site/pages/shared/wired-in.tsx and the three unreferenced public/images/site photos; scripts/space-email-program.test.mjs became a vitest file (scripts/space-email-program.test.ts) so its four assertions now run. NOT done: components/sites/temple-kit-inner/pages-e.ts and its test stay, because the done row LIVE-1689 has a probe that reads that file and its own test pins it, so deleting it is the owner's call (wire the Temple Book page or retire LIVE-1689); components/marketplace/etsy-preview.tsx is the dark fixture UI of the active DEF-ETSY work packet (2026-11-10), so it stays until that packet is wired or retired; components/spaces/dashboard/space-dashboard.tsx has been replaced by manage-dashboard.tsx as the /manage landing but is still named by components/events/series-browse-wiring.test.ts, lib/events/space-events-gate.test.ts and test/e2e/surfaces.ts, so removing it needs those guards re-pointed; the audit's other candidates (Hunts and editor CRDT, intentionally dark until Jan 31) were left alone. The probe wants space-dashboard imported, which would re-mount a superseded dashboard, so it stays red until the owner decides wire or delete.

PARTIAL 2026-11-16, second pass (row stays open): the owner answered the wire-or-delete question at 15:01Z: delete the old Space dashboard. components/spaces/dashboard/space-dashboard.tsx is deleted. It was a component, not a route, so no URL changes and no redirect is needed; nothing imported SpaceDashboard, and the /manage landing is app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/manage-dashboard.tsx. The three guards that named the file drop that entry only: one row of SURFACES in components/events/series-browse-wiring.test.ts, one row of PUBLIC_READERS in lib/events/space-events-gate.test.ts (the same way two readers left on 2026-08-24), and the five space-console-* mask sites in test/e2e/surfaces.ts, whose own guard requires every registered file to exist. Its siblings space-coaching-card.tsx and space-dispatch-band.tsx are live and stay. NOT done: getSpaceProfileStats (lib/spaces/analytics.ts) and getSpaceCompletionAnalytics (lib/spaces/completion-analytics.ts) now have no page caller, but their tests are the coverage for the space, event-type, window and plan binding of the shared readers that live surfaces use, so removing them means re-pointing those tests first. THE PROBE CANNOT PASS AS WRITTEN: its second clause requires a non-test file to import components/spaces/dashboard/space-dashboard, which the owner's delete decision rules out, and its first clause still requires etsy-preview.tsx and temple-kit-inner/pages-e.ts gone (both held, see the first PARTIAL). Closing needs the owner's retime of the probe plus a ruling on those two files.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
